description: This file declares the IController interface within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. The interface includes methods for persisting state, deleting resources, rebooting, retrieving environment variables, configuring, and cloning callsigns. It appears to define a deprecated external interface intended for controlling or managing certain aspects of the framework or plugin host.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling certain framework operations such as persist, delete, reboot, environment management, configuration, and cloning callsigns.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes resources at a specified path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables associated with an index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
